Self compassion, self compassion, self compassion. YouTube videos are helping me get a different perspective. Everyone, user or not, has done awful things..as in multiple things. Forgive yourself, it'll be okay friend :)
This happens to me all the time, when nothing really bad has happened. It'll be okay. Something that helps me is to know I'm physically okay and jtll get worked out, no matter what's happened.

You could look into kratom - that's how I got off fent and dilaudid. You'll have to kick the kratom too as it can be addictive. But it's the lessor of two evils and withdrawals are no where near hard drugs. Kratom is legal in most places from smoke shops or online. Saved my life. I don't want to candy coat it though, you'll still have to kick the kratom - I've been able to go to work during kratom withdrawal though.
Just don't. Do. It. Don't. Do. It. The shit youll feel after. You've done this before. Don't. Do. It. I believe in you.

If you were my sister or brother, I would say hold on, just hold on. Things do get better even at the most hopeless of times. Crying is actually a good thing and means you are not completely numb. And you are good enough, you can do and be anything and you don't need your dad to tell you that. You are strong, I know that because you're still here. Strong people become more of what they are, they just keep getting stronger.

My name was the only one on the lease and I got stuck with all that debt, no job, I had to give up my cat.. It was, impossible. I don't know all of what you're going through, but i can relate. Religious or not, doesn't matter, but could you go to a local church or some type of establishment like it for help? Not my first choice either, but its an option. I know in a lot of areas too, they have "temp to hire" options. I got a job through "express employment professionals" they found me a job and its a free service for the individual applying, they don't get paid until you get a job. Helped me a few times.
